value.rationale: The result is a complete natural first-three-hyperplane extension of the 2026 two-hyperplane optimal-weight problem, not a renaming or cheap normalization check. It exhibits a sharp three-active-mode to two-active-mode transition, proves when equal row weights can be globally rate-optimal, and provides exact optimal relative weights for every parameter of a geometrically motivated family. The rational witness confirms a strict solver-design benefit; a general SDP may compute points but obscures these structural thresholds.
